# Team notes (whiteboard, hour 2 of 5) - IE BCC 2026, Alma Carraovejas

case q: grow sustainably next 5 yrs, keep artisanal identity, deepen sustainability,
connect with next gen. Climate + consumption + rural talent.
deliverable: 15 min + 10 Q&A. exec summary, 3-4 pillars max, roadmap yr1 + 5yr vision, risks

facts (case):
- revenue 32.1m USD 2024 (30.8m 2023) -> +4%. gross profit 23.6m (~74%!)
- 206 employees (189 in 2023), 6 estates, michelin restaurant, own distribution
- harvest 23/24 Spain only 28.45m hl (drought). they bought high altitude: Milsetentayseis 1,076m, Aiurri 600-700m
- spain drinks 24 L/person/yr. under 40 = only ~20% of consumption, gen z 7%
- BUT millennials now 31% vs boomers 26%, 44% of millennials high involvement
- acquisitions Viña Meín, Emilio Rojo, Aiurri = projects w/o successors

our idea (3 pillars, spanish names):
1 RAÍZ - climate: altitude vineyards + regen viticulture, water. pilot on 1 estate then all 6
2 ENCUENTRO - young people: wine tourism + experiences + DTC club, "drink less drink better"
3 OFICIO - talent: academy with local schools, paid harvest apprenticeships, housing?

money: don't overdo it (case says no advanced modelling). DTC + tourism maybe +3m by 2030??
need a driver tree like tajin. ROI? payback ~3y? (guess)
hook: José María 1982 replaced the jug with a bottle in Segovia -> "a loan from the future"
risks: brand dilution, climate year, apprentices leave, tourism capacity
presenters: Ana (analysis), Ben & Carla (strategy), Diego (impact)
